policies: Actual four-mana5/3 Undead root grants the current friendly Hero the existing source-attributed Deathrattle and a source-independent visible player marker. The real Eternal Life child is explicitly flagged VISIBLE_PLAYER_ENCHANTMENT_CARD/HIDE_COST, not an independently playable spell; all three visual/enchantment rows remain complete evidence rather than fake physical casts.

Use existing GrantDeathrattle, AddPlayerEffect and PlayerEffectSpec. The visible marker uses the known physical Husk source face, not a fake physical tooltip spell. The genuine accepted natural Hero death body removes exactly original matching marker instances before its actual debit; source IDs and the original hero_died SourceAllocationFact.next_order bound the consumed set. No hidden behavior/attachment IDs are exposed.

Natural fatal execution uses the actual HeroLethalReference and SpendUpToResource20 with hero_lethal_at_debit. Actual positive committed result recovers only the original episode Hero to that actual health; zero does not recover. All existing fatal barriers, full simultaneous consumption, parked reactions, one-shot grants and terminal/concession rules remain authoritative local interpreter policy.

Source-independent Hero grants persist through source departure/silence. The existing Hero replacement copier already preserves granted attachments, including consumed state, while preserving the visible player effect; no new replacement mechanism is needed. Multiple genuine grants each enter the existing complete natural acceptance/consumption and capped-debit ordering; exact stacking/replacement timing remains M6.

Marker removal is part of the genuine natural Hero Deathrattle body before capped debit, including zero-corpses consumption. Ordinary player-effect hero_died reactions are parked by the existing fatal barrier and can be dropped on terminal, so they cannot own one-shot marker retirement. Opponent-only death cannot consume the friendly effect; post-acceptance new markers are outside the original next_order cutoff. Prohibition and concession retain their existing terminal policies.

No forced nonlethal Hero activation or recovery above the original current max health is approximated; reuse existing strict RecoverHero profile/error. All standard actual sources, formal legality and CN calibration remain open until evidenced.

Two primary historical hotfixes separately support zero-corpse destruction and single-owner response to hero destruction; they do not certify the complete current CN37 timing or replace explicit rule calibration.
